name: Day trader (India)
description: A day-trading method for Indian stocks (NSE, rupees, IST): find setups, time the entry, plan stop and target, size the position, and replay the odds. Analysis only: it never places an order.

skills.name: day-trade-scan
skills.description: Find intraday setups on NSE stocks (opening-range breakout, oversold bounce) from free Yahoo Finance candles, and check the news before choosing

skills.name: day-trade-plan
skills.description: Time an entry on a setup, set the stop and target before entering, size the position from the owner's max loss, and check the plan against the owner's limits

skills.name: day-trade-replay
skills.description: Before a trade, replay the rest of the session many times from the stock's own recent candles and say honestly how often the target or the stop comes first

tools.name: trade-plan
tools.description: Exact arithmetic for one long or short intraday trade: stop, target, quantity from the max loss, capital used, risk to reward, and which limits it breaks. Prices in rupees.

reward_multiple.description: Target as a multiple of the risk per share, for example 1.5

max_loss.description: The most the owner will lose on this trade, in rupees

capital.description: Money available for this trade, in rupees

leverage.description: Intraday leverage the owner has, 1 if none

min_reward_multiple.description: The owner's smallest acceptable reward to risk, 0 if none

tick.description: Price tick, 0.05 for most NSE stocks

tools.name: replay
tools.description: Replays the rest of a session many times. Give the stock's recent 5-minute closes, one past session per line (oldest first), and today's closes so far; it draws returns from the same time of day on past days and counts how often the target or the stop comes first. Seeded, so it repeats.

days.description: Past sessions, oldest first: one session per line, its 5-minute closes from the open separated by commas

today.description: Today's 5-minute closes so far, from the open, separated by commas
